issues.problem: Overstated. What is proved without a Hausdorff base is the UNIT half only: every Hausdorff cone V is ≅ F(V/ℝ₊*), whatever its base (`ConeBase.unitMap`, `unitMap_bijective`, `isGXMorphism_unitMap` take `[T2Space V]` on the cone only; `ConeCex.isoFConeBase`). The COUNIT half F(B)/ℝ₊* ≅ B is proved only for `[T2Space B]` (`baseProj_injective` sits after `variable [T2Space B]`, Lift.lean:737, through `exists_posSMul_eq_of_proj_eq`, and Déf. 3's action on F(B) needs F(B) Hausdorff, `FCone.t2Space` needing `[T2Space B]`); for a general non-Hausdorff locally projective B (e.g. with a doubled point) F(B) need not be Hausdorff, so « inverse over ANY base » is neither proved nor true in that generality. Every other locus (module bullet l.40–50, `not_essSurjAsPrinted_dim` and `isoFConeBase` docstrings, REPORT finding) states it correctly as « V ≅ F(V/ℝ₊*) for every Hausdorff cone, no Hausdorff base needed »
